pages.text: $(#FFD700)Ultimate-only trait$()$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Adaptive I$() (2 slots) — $(item)Compass$()$(br)Automatically picks the best tool mode for what you target — sword for mobs, pickaxe for stone, shovel for dirt, fishing rod in water, etc.$(br2)The Ultimate Tool can bind $(#55FFFF)every trait$() in the mod (8 base slots at T9, +Modifiable).

$(#FFD700)Toggle traits on Ultimate$()$(br2)Shift+Right-click while holding:$(br2)$(li) Silky II — toggle Silk Touch$(br2)$(li) Autosmelt II — toggle autosmelt$(br2)$(li) Broad Touch II — cycle mining area / tree-fell size$(br2)Hold $(#55FFFF)G$() (default) to open the mode wheel when Adaptive is not bound.
